title: Profile & preferences
description: Your details, sign-in security and preferences. They apply to every workspace you belong to.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: How you appear to your teammates.

email.title: Sign-in address
email.description: The address you sign in with and where Gouvra sends account e-mails.

email.sentBody: Open it within 24 hours to finish the change.
email.passwordRequired: Set a password first: changing your sign-in address requires one.
email.unchanged: This is already your sign-in address.

password.title: Password
password.changeDescription: Changing your password signs out your other sessions.

password.setDescriptionNoProvider: Set a password to sign in with your e-mail address.

password.setDoneBody: You can now also sign in with your e-mail address.

connections.title: Connected accounts
connections.description: Sign-in providers linked to your account.

connections.none: No sign-in provider is enabled on this instance.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Saved to your profile and applied on every device you use.

themeDescriptions.dark: Easier on the eyes at night

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Devices where you're signed in. Sign out of any you don't recognise.

sessions.onlyThis: This is your only active session.
sessions.loadError: Your sessions are unavailable right now.
